msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia nteresa-tello-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a long python-print knit maxi dress with a high neck and long sleeves, with black knee boots from the reference, walking at the seafront promenade of Sant Feliu de Guíxols on the Costa Brava, Spain, with the bay and the pine-covered hills, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia nteresa-tello-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a chocolate-brown velvet blazer and matching straight velvet trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia nteresa-tello-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a cream rib-knit off-shoulder maxi dress with a side slit from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia nteresa-tello-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a cream knit mini dress with long flared lace-trimmed sleeves and a crochet hem from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia nteresa-tello-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a brown fitted knit maxi dress with a draped side and faux-fur cuffs from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.

IMAGEN 2 «p6» (formato 3:4, referencia nteresa-tello-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a khaki parka with a big grey faux-fur collar over a white top from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «l2» (formato 3:4, referencia nteresa-tello-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Lifestyle fashion photo: a model wearing a long paisley-embroidered coat with frayed edges over light jeans from the reference, candid and relaxed in a sunny street of Sant Feliu de Guíxols, Spain, natural light, framed from the knees up, editorial, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 5 «b» (formato 16:9, referencia nteresa-tello-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA C): Wide interior photo: the inside of a minimalist boutique with rails of dark knitwear and coats, grey textured plaster walls and a few pairs of shoes on a light floor, no people, inspired by the reference, photographed like a design magazine, beautiful natural light, inviting and tidy. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
